rationale: The final Pulp SDK release path reproduced a native crash in the transferred text-shaping kernel. TextRunPlanner's asynchronous batch path captured a loop-local reference binding after its lifetime ended, and AddressSanitizer then proved concurrent SkParagraph shaping double-freed entries in the shared FontCollection face cache. Pulp must carry the minimal memory-safety repair immediately so panel and plug-in UI text shaping is safe while Vellum issue #14 ports the same repair to the authoritative framework. The exception changes no public API and expires within fourteen days.
